spec.assertion: Escalation is keyed to isabel's OWN burst cast. CF-A re-keys the blocks to fullBurstEnter; with a second Burst III (helm) in the fixture the team makes more Full Bursts than isabel makes casts, so CF-A yields strictly more stage applications and strictly more damage — GREEN under burstCast, RED under full-burst-enter.

Asserts a self-targeted critRatePct buffApply of 6.26 with a finite expiresFrame and NO durationShots. Fails under the scoped-crit nearest-wrong (critRateNormalPct, which would under-credit her skill/burst crit) and under a round-count duration reading.

critDamagePct=18.03 exists and its application COUNT is strictly less than critRatePct's. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'all three stages granted on the first cast' (counts equal) and under a stage-1-only model (count 0).

atkPct=17.28 exists, count strictly less than critDamagePct's, and no casterAtkPct is emitted. Enforces the strict monotone ladder cr > cd > atk (fails a non-escalating model) and pins 'ATK ▲' as self-scaling atkPct rather than the caster-scaled flat-ATK path.
Inertness: zero buffApply events with isabel as caster and a non-isabel target for any of the three stats. Fails an allies-scoped mis-target.

⚑ The kit gives this damage line NO activation clause, so the trigger cadence is an invented/datamined value outside the blind input domain. fixtures: controlComp('isabel', true) for every run — liter B1 / crown B2 / isabel B3 / helm B3, Fire boss, focus isabel. B1+B2 are mandatory: isabel is Burst III and a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts, which would render every burst-keyed assertion vacuous. The fixed helm B3 slot is deliberately kept ON (not passed false): it is the SECOND Burst-III unit, and without it the team's Full Burst count would equal isabel's own burst-cast count, making burstCast and fullBurstEnter indistinguishable — the divergence is the whole discriminator for skill1's trigger identity. A fixture-sanity block asserts fullBurstStart count > isabel's own burstCast count so that premise is checked, not assumed, plus >=3 own casts (the escalation caps at 3 over the 180s / 40s-cd fight) and a pre-first-cast window with no Marked Target active (non-vacuity for both the active and inactive case). 6 hoisted runs: base + 5 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (skill1 re-keyed to fullBurstEnter; skill1 stripped; Damage Taken re-scoped to self; fullBurstExtend removed; skill2 stripped).
gaps: skill2 'Affects 5 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' — it.skip: v1 models a single partless boss with no enemy final-DEF ranking, so the 5-target fan-out collapses to one hit and is unobservable. Needs a multi-enemy primitive.
burst 'Affects all enemies' — it.skip: single-boss v1 makes an all-enemies burst indistinguishable from a single-target one.

skill2 cadence — NOT it.skip'd but deliberately UNASSERTED (⚑): the kit gives the 170.58% damage line no activation clause, so its trigger period is outside the blind input domain (ALWAYS-⚑ field #2, 'a damage line the text gives NO trigger for'). Structurally it must be an `interval` trigger; the period itself is a datamined/estimated value the driver must flag. Recipe to close: read the datamined skill cooldown for skill2 and/or popup-count isabel's non-normal, non-burst hits per minute in a solo recording.

burst noFb on the staged riders — unasserted: whether the 299.7% / 349.65% additional-damage components are Full-Burst-exempt is a per-kit MEASURED-only field (⚑ #6, default OFF). The burst cast lands before the FB window opens, so the base 149.85% is FB-exempt by convention, but the riders' timing relative to the FB banner is not derivable from prose.

Marked Target stage persistence vs the 45 sec window — unasserted: the burst branch reads 'each stage of Marked Target', and the skill1 stages expire after 45 sec while her burst cooldown is 40 sec. Whether an expired stage-1 buff also DEMOTES the burst branch's stage (vs the stage counter being a monotone use-count independent of the buff window) is not resolvable from the prose. The monotone-ladder assertion is written to hold under either reading over the first three casts, where the 40s cd keeps every stage inside its 45s window; a divergence would only appear on a delayed 4th+ cast.
